checks.name: No hard-coded colours in component code (use shared design tokens)

cannotTest: Almost all of this rule needs human judgement: whether the interface is friendly, intuitive and polished; form guidance, focus order, inline validation and tooltips; the adaptive prediction engine (confidence thresholds of 50% and 80%, suggestion behaviour, kernel/adapter architecture, learning, per-user isolation and calibration); the theme-creation wizard; and overall visual quality, animation and accessibility. These must be judged by a reviewer and by behavioural tests. Note that this app is a button component library, not a form or application, so most of the form and prediction requirements apply to apps that consume it. The single automatic check only guards the one measurable part: no hard-coded colour values in component code.
